content.comment_body: Were you able to solve the issue? I'm facing the same challenge.
Hello [user_name], Could you please write in English? Here's a translation:
Apologies! Were you able to get it working? I have the same problem; I can count clockwise rotations but not counterclockwise ones. I watched this [url] but couldn't figure out how to implement it.

Thread closed as the question was posted twice. The other topic, titled [company_name] and encoder at low rpm losing position CW/CCW, is now available in the [product_name] - Software section. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces difficulty distinguishing clockwise and counterclockwise rotation directions using an encoder with [product_name]. While clockwise counting works, counterclockwise does not. External instructions have been reviewed but have not helped resolve the issue. The product lacks clear and intuitive guidance for this type of encoder setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to reliably detect both clockwise and counterclockwise rotation from the encoder and to provide straightforward configuration instructions.
